tools.name: ncrypt_create_share_link
tools.description: Upload a document to Ncrypt and return a private share link. The recipient must enter their name and a valid email address before they can read a single page, the file is encrypted at rest, and downloads are denied until the owner approves them. Supply the file as base64 content, a public https URL,

tools.name: ncrypt_add_share_link
tools.description: Create an additional share link for a document that already exists. A document can be shared as many times as needed. Each link carries its own code and trace code, so the view history records which share each viewer came through.

tools.name: ncrypt_list_documents
tools.description: List the documents in the owner's Ncrypt workspace with their share codes and view counts.

tools.name: ncrypt_get_view_analytics
tools.description: Return who viewed a document, when, on what device and for how long.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ncrypt_create_share_link · Private data: ncrypt_create_share_link, ncrypt_add_share_link, ncrypt_list_documents, ncrypt_get_view_analytics · Public sink: ncrypt_create_share_link, ncrypt_add_share_link, ncrypt_list_documents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ncrypt_create_share_link · Private data: ncrypt_create_share_link, ncrypt_add_share_link, ncrypt_list_documents, ncrypt_get_view_analytics · Public sink: ncrypt_create_share_link, ncrypt_add_share_link, ncrypt_list_documents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
